body: Parks, Recreation and Community Services Commission Special Meeting
agenda_text:
PARKS, RECREATION & COMMUNITY SERVICES COMMISSION

Welcome to the meeting of the Parks, Recreation & Community Services Commission. Meetings are broadcast live on cable channel 6 (GTV6) and rebroadcast
throughout the week. Call (818) 548-4013 for program schedules. DVDs and videotapes of the proceedings are available for purchase in the City Clerk’s Office by calling
(818) 548-2090. Meetings are also archived on the City website for viewing anytime at www.ci.glendale.ca.us/video_archives.asp.
PLEASE TURN OFF CELLULAR PHONES AND PAGERS WHILE INSIDE THE COUNCIL CHAMBERS.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign language translation, and Braille transcripts are available upon request.
Assisted listening devices are available same-day upon request. At least 48 hours (or two business days) notice is required for requests regarding sign language
translation and Braille transcription services. All documents related to open session items on this agenda that are received less than 72 hours prior to this meeting, and
are public records, will be available for review in the Community Services & Parks Administration Office, 613 E. Broadway, Room 120, Glendale, CA 91206. If you have
any question about matters on the agenda, or requests for assistance, please contact (818) 548-2782 during regular business hours.

  SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA
  Monday, January 28, 2019, 2:30 p.m.
  Council Chambers, 613 E. Broadway, 2nd Floor, Glendale, CA 91206

  A SPECIAL MEETING of the Parks, Recreation & Community Services Commission is hereby
called to meet at 2:30 p.m. on Monday, January 28, 2019, in the City Council Chambers, 613 E.
Broadway, 2nd Floor, Glendale, CA 91206 to consider the following item of business, to wit:

1.  ROLL CALL
  A. Report of Recording Clerk, re: Posting of the Agenda. The Agenda for the January 28, 2019,
  special meeting was posted on the bulletin board outside City Hall on or before Friday, January 25,
  2019.
2.  INTRODUCTIONS AND PRESENTATIONS
  A.  Recognition of Members of the Community for Art Exhibits at the Adams Square Gas
  Station
  B.  Recognition of Nancy Serpa for Outstanding Service to the Seniors in the Glendale
  Community

3.  UPCOMING COUNCIL AGENDA ITEMS
4.  COMMISSION/STAFF COMMENTS
5.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Discussion is limited to items not a part of this agenda. Each speaker is allowed five (5) minutes. The
  Commission may question the speaker, but there will be no debate or decision. The Director may refer
  the matter to the proper section for investigation and report.
6.  CONSENT ITEMS (Including Minutes)
  The following are routine and may be acted upon by one motion. Any member of the Commission or
  audience requesting separate consideration may do so by making such request before a motion is
  proposed.
  A.  Approval of the Minutes of the Commission regular meeting held on December 17, 2018.
7.  ACTION ITEMS
  A. Updated and New Department Wide Fees for Rentals
  1. A Resolution repealing the fee amount for the existing Film Permit Site Host Fee and
  establishing a new fee amount; and establishing new fees for rental of various facilities and
  equipment; and recommending that the Glendale City Council incorporate into the
  “Comprehensive Citywide Fee Schedule” the changes made to the CSP Department Wide Fee
  Schedule, effective March 1, 2019
 8.  REPORTS – INFORMATION ONLY
  A. Mobile Recreation Program Annual Report
  B. Section Activity Reports
  1.  Workforce Development
  2.  Recreation & Community Services
  3.  Park Services

9.  ADJOURNMENT

  Onnig Bulanikian
  Director of Community Services & Parks

  Members of the public may address the Parks, Recreation & Community Services Commission

minutes_text:
PARKS, RECREATION & COMMUNITY SERVICES COMMISSION

  SPECIAL MEETING MINUTES
  Monday, January 28, 2019, 2:30 p.m.
  Council Chambers, 613 E. Broadway, 2nd Floor, Glendale, CA 91206

1.  ROLL CALL

  The meeting was called to order at 2:35 p.m.

  Present: Commissioners Babaian, Kalfayan, Michals, Wolfson, and President Asatryan
  Absent: None

  A.  Report of Recording Clerk, re: Posting of the Agenda. Ms. Moreno Hernandez reported that the
  agenda for the January 28, 2019, special meeting was posted on the bulletin board outside City
  Hall on or before Friday, January 25, 2019.
2.  INTRODUCTIONS AND PRESENTATIONS
  A. Recognition of Members of the Community for Art Exhibits at the Adams Square Gas
  Station
  This item was taken out of order after item 7A1 to accommodate those being recognized.

  B.  Recognition of Nancy Serpa for Outstanding Service to the Seniors in the Glendale
  Community
  This item was tabled, as Nancy Serpa was unable to attend the meeting.

3.  UPCOMING COUNCIL AGENDA ITEMS
  Director of Community Services & Parks Onnig Bulanikian read a list of upcoming City Council agenda
  items related to the Community Services & Parks Department (CSP).

4.  COMMISSION/STAFF COMMENTS
  Deputy Director of Community Services & Parks Koko Panossian announced at any calls regarding
  trees are now taken by Public Works Forestry, as of January 1st, even if the trees are in parks.

  Ms. Moreno Hernandez announced upcoming events organized or sponsored by the Community
  Services & Parks Department.

  President Asatryan asked staff to consider the possibility of holding Commission meetings in the
  neighborhoods, similar to what City Council practices, as well as look into Commissioner Wolfson’s
  previous request of changing the Commission meeting hours to the evening to make it more feasible for
  the community to attend. Mr. Bulanikian said that staff would see if the resources are available to
  implement such changes.

  Commissioner Wolfson suggested holding an annual Parks & Recreation meeting at one of the parks.
5.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  None
  1
 6.  CONSENT ITEMS (Including Minutes)
  A. Approval of the Minutes of the Commission regular meeting held on December 17, 2018.

  Moved:  Commissioner Michals
  Seconded: Commissioner Babaian

  That the minutes of the Commission regular meeting held on December 17, 2018, be
  approved as submitted.

  A roll call was conducted and Commissioners voted as follows:

  Ayes:  Commissioners Babaian, Kalfayan, Michals, Wolfson, and President Asatryan
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  None
  Abstain:  None

7.  ACTION ITEMS
  A. Updated and New Department Wide Fees for Rentals
  1. A Resolution repealing the fee amount for the existing Film Permit Site Host Fee and
  establishing a new fee amount; and establishing new fees for rental of various facilities and
  equipment; and recommending that the Glendale City Council incorporate into the
  “Comprehensive Citywide Fee Schedule” the changes made to the CSP Department Wide Fee
  Schedule, effective March 1, 2019.
  Senior Services Supervisor Gabrielle Goglia presented the proposed fees in detail.

  Some Commissioners expressed concerns regarding various non-profit fees and suggested
  potentially raising the standard and commercial rate for rental of the LED screen.

  After much discussion, a motion was made to adopt a resolution approving the fees as
  presented, and directing staff to bring back a report as an action item regarding the fee
  structure, in order to be able to make changes to the non-profit rate, if desired by Commission.

  Moved:  Commissioner Kalfayan
  Seconded: Commissioner Wolfson

  A roll call was conducted and Commissioners voted as follows:

  Ayes: Commissioners Babaian, Kalfayan, Michals, Wolfson, and President Asatryan
  Noes: None
  Absent: None
  Abstain: None

Item 2A. Recognition of Members of the Community for Art Exhibits at the Adams Square Gas
Station was taken out of order at this time.
  Deputy Director of Community Services & Parks Tereza Aleksanian provided some history of the
  holiday art exhibits, showing images of the past and most recent exhibits. Those recognized
  included: Cathy Hrenda, Stephen Meek, Nick Macierz, Arlene Vidor, John Muir Elementary School
  Faculty Advisors Lana Huleis and Agnessa Vardani, as well as the John Muir Elementary School
  Student Council.

  2
 8.  REPORTS – INFORMATION ONLY
  A. Mobile Recreation Program Annual Report
  Community Services Coordinator Meline Amazaspyan provided a PowerPoint presentation
  covering the following: background on the Mobile Recreation Program, Party on the Go! packages,
  Party on the Go! rentals, Glendale Rocks! packages, Glendale Rocks! rentals, Fiscal Impact, and
  Mobile Recreation marketing. Commissioners had no questions.

  B.  Section Activity Reports
  1.  Workforce Development
  Workforce Development Administrator Judith Velasco provided a report regarding the release
  of a draft amended local plan for public comment and the California Workforce Development
  Board’s assistance to the Los Angeles basin workforce boards with services to individuals with
  disabilities. Commissioners had no questions.

  2.  Recreation & Community Services
  No oral report or presentation was provided. Mr. Bulanikian referred the Commission to the
  written report submitted. Commissioners had no questions.

  3.  Park Services
  No oral report or presentation was provided. Mr. Bulanikian referred the Commission to the
  written report submitted. Commissioners had no questions.

9.  ADJOURNMENT
  The meeting was adjourned at 4:08 p.m.
